frozen_branch.P_prime: a post-M / post-Lemma10 source state satisfying (i)-(v)
frozen_branch.L0: chosen 3-list with two selected active colors

definitions.competing_survivor: A final post-seed-two/post-normalization vertex v in Y intersect N(Y0) with exact 3-list L(v)=L' != L0.
definitions.source_Z_survivor: A competing survivor whose pre-seed provenance lies in the source set Z(L').
definitions.witness_mask_J_v: {i in {1,2}: yi is nonadjacent to v and ci belongs to L(v)}.
definitions.Y0_component_profile_A_v: The set of connected components C of the final G[Y0] to which v is complete.
definitions.stored_support_profile_Q_v: The exact adjacency vector from v to the bounded stored support S(Q), retaining role/color labels.
definitions.coarse_signature: (L(v), old source type T(v), witness mask J(v), stored support profile Q(v)).
definitions.full_candidate_fiber_signature: (coarse_signature, Y0 component profile, certified P7-support implication tags).
definitions.fiber_system: The canonical relational structure of full candidate fiber signatures together with proof-relevant adjacency relations among their survivor classes and multiplicities.
definitions.proof_sufficient_partition: A partition of Z-survivors for which replacing per-vertex handling by one representative/state per block preserves extension coverage, source-normal-subcase legality, the local P7/support deductions used by this repair, and polynomial reconstruction.
definitions.rho_Z: Minimum number of blocks in a proof-sufficient partition. This is NOT defined as the raw number of vertices or raw number of list classes.

source_exact_reductions_to_prove_first.Z_CAPTURE: Every final competing 3-list survivor is a source_Z_survivor.
source_exact_reductions_to_prove_first.Y0_COMPONENT_UNIFORMITY: For every survivor v and every connected component C of final G[Y0], v is either complete or anticomplete to C.
source_exact_reductions_to_prove_first.COARSE_COORDINATE_BOUND: For fixed seed S and frozen Q-construction, the number of possible coarse signatures is bounded by a function B(|S|), independent of |V(G)|.
source_exact_reductions_to_prove_first.HARD_CORE_LOCALIZATION: Any unbounded proof-distinct fiber diversity must therefore use Y0-component incidence and/or relational interactions among survivor fibers; it cannot come solely from list/source-type/selected-witness/stored-support coordinates.

main_target.name: NONEDGE_Z_SURVIVOR_INTERFACE_COMPRESSION
main_target.tier_A: rho_Z <= O(1) under the frozen source domain.
main_target.tier_C: Even if rho_Z is not seed-bounded, the complete set of proof-sufficient canonical survivor-fiber systems needed by the repair can be generated in at most |V(G)|^{q(|S|)} states with polynomial reconstruction.
main_target.fail: An explicit arbitrary-N source-valid family proving that every proof-sufficient representation requires superpolynomially many distinct interface states/choices.

independence_killer.question: Can arbitrarily many survivor fibers remain proof-independent after all source/P7 constraints?
not_enough_for_fail: unbounded number of raw neighborhood sets
independence_killer.required_for_fail: Show superpolynomial growth of proof-distinct interface states or an equivalent lower bound against every representation admitted by the frozen gate.

allow: vertex renaming preserving exact partitions, seed colors, lists, source types, support roles and all frozen relations
color renaming only under a verified symmetry of the entire branch
multiplicity aggregation only when a proof establishes that future local repair behavior is multiplicity-insensitive except for the retained count
forbid: dropping Y0 incidence merely because lists/types match
assuming false-twin equivalence without exact relation proof
quotienting survivor-survivor adjacency without a behavior-preservation proof
equating raw signature equality with proof sufficiency
